South Africa Protests Turn Violent Over Asylum Ruling

Violent anti-immigration protests erupted in Soweto and Durban, South Africa, on Thursday, October 8, following a Constitutional Court ruling that eased restrictions on asylum applications. During the protests, cars were burned and shops were looted.
